title: Baby Sandy in Stroller, 1957 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A December 1957 black-and-white snapshot showing a 7-month-old baby seated in a vintage metal baby stroller against a cinder block wall outdoors. Annotations on the front border read 'Sandy - 7 mos.' and 'at Gloria's house'. It offers a candid glimpse into 1950s American suburban family life.
